entities.title: No shared high-score table
entities.summary: The ten best hauls are saved only in the player's browser; the Worker keeps no scores.
entities.impact: Players can't compare hauls, and clearing the browser's storage loses the table.

entities.title: No bloom on the web
entities.summary: The web export uses the Compatibility renderer, which draws the game's bright colours without the HDR glow the desktop renderer adds.
entities.impact: The browser game looks flatter than it does in the Godot editor.

entities.title: A 40 MB first load
entities.summary: The Godot engine is about 39.5 MB of WebAssembly, fetched before the title screen appears.
entities.impact: The first visit on a slow or metered connection takes a while; the browser caches it for an hour.
